description:
BROE auctioneers are delighted to present this charming 3-bedroom mid-terrace family home, complete with a private garden.
The bright and airy layout includes a porch, an entrance hallway, a living room, and a kitchen/dining room. Upstairs, you will find three bedrooms, along with the main family bathroom. The rear garden features a small block shed and benefits from access via a rear laneway. 
Located just a short stroll from Clondalkin Village, this home is close to various amenities, including shops, schools, and leisure facilities. Additionally, it is only a few minutes drive from the M50, N7, and N4 motorways, providing easy access to all parts of the country. There is also ample off-street parking available at the front of the property. 
This superb home has much to offer, and we recommend scheduling an early viewing. 

Contact BROE auctioneers to express your interest.
